turnaround_reason: A high-quality research/advisory franchise de-rated ~61% on fears that AI erodes the paid-research model, plus decelerating contract-value growth (net contract value increase turned negative in Q1). Recovery hinges on CV growth reaccelerating and AskGartner defending the moat.
bullish_points: Elite economics: 70% gross margin, 23% EBITDA margin, $1.05B FCF
Q2 beat and raised buyback authorization
Contract value growth reaccelerated to +4.9% cc in Q2 after the Q1 dip
Forward P/E ~10.5 vs a long-standing premium multiple
Sticky subscription base plus new AskGartner AI tool to defend the franchise
bearish_points: Stock plunged ~27% in Aug despite beating — the growth narrative is broken
CV growth decelerating; NCVI went negative in Q1
AI is a genuine existential question for syndicated research (why pay when you have an LLM?)
No near-term catalyst until the Nov print
Negative book value from years of buybacks
catalyst: Q3 earnings showing contract-value growth re-acceleration
suggested_trade: Spot, small — quality at a discount but with an AI overhang; scale in below ~$165
key_risk: Contract value growth keeps decelerating and AI structurally disrupts the research-subscription model
would_skip_if: Q3 contract value growth decelerates again
